Interesting Yet Delicious!
Sep 2026 • Couples
Walked-in for a mid-afternoon lunch. There was only 1 couple dining and we got seated inmediately. We took several minutes reviewing their menu and after making our selections we put in our order. Our wait time for our orders to come out was around 15 minutes. We had the 3-course vegetarian selection and green fried rice with vegetables. Yes, green fried rice! The food had an interesting look and tasted really good! Vegetables were fresh and the green fried rice had a crunchy ingredient we could not figure out. We loved it—it was delicious! Service was good and the wait staff was polite and fluent in English. The atmosphere was quiet and casual, without the rush of the street below impacting the atmosphere. BOM is located just beside Actos hotel, steps from a busy round about close to the Ben Thanh market.

Familiar Vietnamese Flavors with an Elegant Touch
Jul 2026 • Solo
“Bánh Đập” Pâté — I liked that the rice cracker was crunchy, but not so hard that it took extra effort to bite into. The pâté was smooth and creamy without being overly fishy, while the scallion oil added freshness and aroma. Each bite was flavorful, and I thought the portion was just right.

Seafood Rice Noodle Roll — The rice noodle was silky, delicate, and incredibly soft, though a little slippery from the sauce. The seafood filling was flavorful, and the garnishes on top added color to the dish Overall, I would say this was an elevated take on bánh cuốn.

Local Grilled White Pomfret — The char on the pomfret was noticeable, and the skin was crispy without tasting burnt. The fish itself was fresh, moist, and tender, while the herbs were fresh and fragrant. I just wish there had been more sauce, as I didn’t think there was quite enough for the amount of fish and greens on the plate.

Young Rice Panna Cotta — The panna cotta was silky and delicate. It was tasty, with just the right amount of sweetness without being very sweet.

The service was excellent.

Best meal in Ho Chi Minh
Apr 2026 • Family
Super delicious food, a great wine list and reasonable prices. We ordered a mix of starters including chicken skewers, tuna tataki, spring rolls and garlic butter seafood. All were great and much better/different to what we expeyfeom the menu.

The same theme occurred with the mains. The fish dishes we chose and the beef were all exceptionally well executed but the chicken roulade was even better with delicious Vietnamese flavours coming through what is more often a European dish.

The wine list looked excellent but unfortunately they'd sold out of quite a lot of the nicer wines. We settled on an American cab sauv which we liked enough to go through 2 bottles between the 3 of us. 

If there's only one restaurant you get to in Ho Chi Minh, make it this one.

Excellent food, service, drinks, high quality
Mar 2026 • Friends
We had the 3 and 5 course fixe lunch special, actually we came here twice for this because it was so good. The second time we brought a group of my son’s friends who were only in town for the morning. This is a high quality restaurant and everything from the food to the drinks are great. The duck spring rolls are crispy & delicious and served elegantly in little baskets separated from the greens. The pepper elder salad has shrimp with a delicious blend of greens that was so good. The betel leaf wrap was unique and tasted great. The Bo Kho tart was good, but we wish it had more of the true Vietnamese Bo Kho flavor, but the crust was very nice. 

The drinks here are also excellent. We ordered a pot of jasmine tea and 2 glasses of ice. The tea was incredibly fragrant and the iced tea was so fresh because of the way it was prepared and served. The pear mocktail was delicate and delicious, as were the other mocktails served. They really do a fine job on their beverages too. 

For dessert they ran out of the mochi and were going to serve us a brownie, but we asked for a different substitute and they kindly gave us a dessert with coconut and ice cream instead, it was really good. 

We would like to come back here and try more of their menu, as the food, the beverages, the service all are top rate here.

BOM certainly understands food ❤️
Nov 2025 • Solo
From viewing the menu at the door I was very impressed. I was tired, hungry and totally inappropriately dressed. However as it is my last night here I thought the worst that can happen is they say we're fully booked. If you do nothing else in Ho Chi Minh you must eat at Boa. Starting with very professional service, they make a good Whiskey Sour (more difficult than you might think), I would seriously love the recipe for the chilli and fish sauce crackers. There are no words to explain the duck spring rolls and sauce, just perfect. My only observation, my main course, the duck with lotus, which was delicious, was served before I had finished my entree and was therefore a little cold. Also the duck was a little tough, the lotus was very tasty but again the purée could have been warmer. Don't let my fussy culinary comments deter you, this is a great experience. I also dined alone and felt very comfortable doing so here. My biggest complaint, you are located a very long way from my home in Australia.

HCM City's hidden gem
Oct 2025 • Couples
Stumbled on to this hidden gem when we saw the 'kitchen & wine bar' neon sign over an unassuming doorway. After two weeks of traditional Vietnamese food, we were keen for something different. The staff were great, the atmosphere chilled, and the meals; chicken risotto and kumquat pork did not disappoint. 
The wine list is extensive but unfortunately expensive; but that just seems to be wine in Vietnam! I would come back here everyday to eat but I would have to drink the wine .....and that would blow the budget!
PS the table near us ordered a tray of small cakes for dessert, and it looked awesome too!
